separate_findings.finding: discount_applied=true asserts an applied discount; the source only proposes a conditional target.
Jo rejects Mina's proposal is stronger than the cited collective choice of an alternative; not an explicit rejection by Jo.
counter-proposal descriptor conflicts with scegliamo, which states a decision.
Literal timestamps are attached to standalone timestamp entities; proposal/decision/suspension items themselves have no temporal fields.

Managing-team/panel claim uses a pilot-statement item and objective item as endpoints; it does not explicitly identify Aster and panel entity endpoints. Universal endpoints permit this structurally; usefulness requires review.
discount_assigned=false and delivery_date_known=false preserve the unknown assignment/date.
Temporary crowd avoidance, weather-dependent future intention and unconfirmed attendance are retained without diagnosis/personality inference.
